scope: Targeted primary-source novelty assessment, not an exhaustive priority proof. Relevant published constructions and recent preprints are distinguished.

entries.inspected: Nominal/robust predictive-filter construction and retained Task05 reconstruction
entries.relation: Existing continuation and terminal protection already solves prior selected failures; retained unchanged.

entries.inspected: Output-feedback bound/terminal assumptions, equation18; original code access documented in Task05
entries.relation: Uncertainty-aware protection is established; this task does not introduce it.

entries.title: Eyes-Closed Safety Kernels: Safety for Autonomous Systems Under Loss of Observability
entries.inspected: Full PDF obtained; information structure, eyes-closed kernel and execution in SectionsII-III read
entries.relation: Blackout-compatible safety and reachability already studied; self-state/external-observation split differs from the exact multimodal self-state information set here.

entries.title: Control Barrier Function Meets Interval Analysis: Safety-Critical Control with Measurement and Actuation Uncertainties
entries.inspected: Open full PDF, interval sampled-data conditions and higher-relative-degree extension, Propositions1-3
entries.relation: Positive uncertainty-tube safety checks are prior work. Our negative certificates do not rely on failure of that sufficient search.

entries.title: Generator-Independent Runtime Assurance under Partial Observation
entries.status: arXiv preprint, v1, 5 September2026, not asserted peer reviewed
entries.inspected: HTML full text accessed; definitions, Theorem2 and common-action construction read
entries.relation: Generic observational incompatibility is explicitly covered already. No first-discovery claim for ambiguous observations preventing reliable useful admission is defensible from this task.

entries.title: Convex Optimization
entries.inspected: Author-hosted bibliographic/book page; our residual inequality is independently derived in full
entries.relation: Linear alternatives/dual certificates are classical. The contribution is a checked spacecraft specialization and concrete multi-hypothesis witnesses, not a new alternative theorem.

novelty_decision: No broad novel control or general impossibility theorem is claimed. Test the usefulness of the concrete two-sided certificate diagnostic separately in Task07; do not rename generic partial-information viability as a breakthrough.
